sources: The Resulticks acquisition ($1.5B) is the largest and most complex, adding a separate AI-driven customer data platform that will require significant systems integration, sales alignment, and product consolidation work.
This will likely extend the integration tax into 2027 and beyond.
prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage. Bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design.
2. One dominant flat block-colour background for the whole shot: deep magenta. Never a rainbow, never a gradient.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Never a recognisable person's face.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the background's contrasting colour. Real paper texture, print dots, small tape pieces.
5. Consistent upper-left light. Small paper-layer shadows only.
6. Everything is flat matte printed paper. No glow, no neon, no bloom, no halos, no luminous edges. Nothing emits light. Not glossy 3D. Not live action.
7. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif, black or cream, printed on paper chips, large, safe margins. English spelling and letterforms accurate and stable. Only the headline text in the copy list, nothing else.
8. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window. One strongest visual focus at a time. No camera shake. Movement starts on the first frame; a small loop continues at the end. No empty frames.
9. Numbers, when specified, are printed complete from their first visible frame. Never counting up, never morphing, never redrawn.
10. No brands, logos, watermarks, or text beyond the copy list.
11. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
12. Identity anchor: rough white torn-paper edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: deep magenta.
Subjects: the wedge; a paper calendar strip.
Opens on the wedge, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The wedge unrolls into a calendar strip that stretches out past the frame edge.
Ends holding on the calendar strip.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "INTO 2027".

COPY LIST: "INTO 2027". Exact strings; nothing else appears in frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "The Resulticks deal is the largest and most complex, and likely extends the integration tax into twenty twenty-seven.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a 2D-animated modern editorial paper collage. The scene opens on <Picture 1>, featuring a flat, matte deep magenta background. In the center, a black-and-white halftone photographic cutout of a wedge-shaped paper scrap with rough white torn-paper edges is visible, partially obscured by a cream-colored paper strip held by a piece of translucent matte tape. The lighting is consistent from the upper-left, casting small, subtle paper-layer shadows beneath the elements. A narrator (S1), a male with a warm, clear, and natural mid-range timbre and a brisk but unhurried speaking rate, begins speaking immediately: <d>[English] The Resulticks deal is the largest and most complex, and likely extends the integration tax into twenty twenty-seven.</d> As S1 speaks, the black-and-white halftone wedge rapidly unrolls and expands, transforming into a long, horizontal paper calendar strip that stretches smoothly across the screen and past the right frame edge. The calendar strip maintains its halftone texture and rough white torn edges. Simultaneously, a new paper chip in cream matte paper slides into the composition with a fast motion and slight overshoot, landing stably. Printed on this chip in a large, extra-bold black sans-serif typeface is the text "INTO 2027", which is clean, legible, and stable. The camera remains in a Static Shot throughout the 5 seconds, maintaining the flat 2D composition. The video ends with a hold on the fully extended calendar strip and the headline, with a subtle, rhythmic pulsing motion of the paper elements to create a loop.

overall_soundscape: The audio features the clear, dry vocal of the narrator. Beneath the voice, synchronized diegetic sound effects include the crisp, tactile slap of heavy paper landing on a surface and the short, sticky peel and press sound of adhesive tape.
